clue.text: Creating task for teachers right away

indicators.note: away tells us the letter for right is sent off from the longer word

parts.note: teachers spend evenings on marking pupils' work

explanation.surface: A setter of homework is told to get the marking done straight away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'right away' reads as 'immediately', but it splits: R (right) is taken away from MARKING.
explanation.definitionFit: Making and creating are synonyms, both meaning bringing something into being.

clue.text: Watergate clue is contrived

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so the letters of the two words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Watergate-scandal clue is suspected of being made up.
explanation.walkthrough: Watergate looks like the Nixon scandal, but here it is literally a gate controlling water.
explanation.definitionFit: A sluice is a sliding gate that controls the flow of water in a channel, a literal water gate.

clue.text: Some singing lady sings for girl

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A female singer performs on behalf of a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition included 'for', which is only a link word joining wordplay to definition; the definition is 'girl'.
explanation.definitionFit: Gladys is a female given name, and crosswords freely clue first names by 'girl'.

clue.text: French woman gets first man to interrupt me

indicators.note: to interrupt means to break into, so the first man goes inside the word me

parts.note: Adam was the first man in the Bible

explanation.surface: A Frenchwoman lets the first man cut in while she is speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Madame is the French title for a married woman, so it stands for a French woman.

clue.text: Pale flame damaged national emblem

indicators.note: damaged suggests the two words are knocked out of shape into a new order

explanation.surface: A flag bearing a national symbol is scorched by a weak flame.
explanation.definitionFit: The red maple leaf is Canada's national symbol, shown on its flag.

clue.text: Quote about funny great tobacco product

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for quote goes round the jumble

parts.note: to cite is to quote

indicators.note: funny means odd, so the letters of great are mixed up

explanation.surface: A quotation about a wonderful smoke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'funny' reads as describing the quote's humour, but it only tells you to jumble the word after it.
explanation.definitionFit: A cigarette is rolled tobacco for smoking, one of the commonest products made from the leaf.

clue.text: Mistake in court when moving out of flat

indicators.note: moving means shifting position, so the letters of the three words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A tenant makes an error in a legal court while moving out of a flat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'court' looks like a law court but is a tennis court.
explanation.definitionFit: In tennis, a foot fault is the error of stepping over the baseline while serving.

clue.text: State car at Adriatic resort

parts.note: RI is the postal abbreviation for Rhode Island, a US state
the Mini is a famous small British car

explanation.surface: A government car parked at a seaside resort on the Adriatic.
explanation.definitionFit: Rimini is a popular beach town on Italy's Adriatic coast.

clue.text: Minister in study entertaining a commanding officer

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the room holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a den is a private study room
CO is the military abbreviation for commanding officer

explanation.surface: A government minister hosts an army officer in his study.
explanation.definitionFit: A deacon is an ordained church officer, and a minister is a member of the clergy.

clue.text: Reluctant to give details when ape not quiet

indicators.note: not here means without, so the letter for quiet is taken out

parts.note: to ape is to copy or imitate
P (piano) is the musical abbreviation for quiet

explanation.surface: Someone is cagey when asked to imitate without making a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Being coy means being evasive or shy about revealing information.

clue.text: Wrist adornment no good wrapped in bundle of hay

indicators.note: wrapped in means enclosed, so the abbreviation sits inside the bundle

parts.note: a bale is a tied bundle of hay

explanation.surface: A worthless bracelet is found tucked inside a hay bale.
explanation.definitionFit: A bangle is a rigid bracelet worn round the wrist as jewellery.

clue.text: Source of illumination was ahead

definitions.meaning: a light-emitting diode, a small electronic lamp
past tense of lead, to be in front

explanation.surface: A lamp was out in front.
explanation.definitionFit: The acronym names a light-emitting diode, and it is also the past tense of the verb lead, to be in front.

clue.text: Detective's hustle revolutionary

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking definition to wordplay

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning things over, so the letters of hustle are rearranged

explanation.surface: A detective's hurried approach is groundbreaking.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleuth is an informal word for a detective, from sleuth-hound, a tracking dog.

clue.text: Ale brewed in meadow

indicators.note: brewed means stirred up, so the letters of the beer are mixed

explanation.surface: Beer made in a field.
explanation.definitionFit: Lea is a poetic word for a grassy field or pasture.

clue.text: Some broad avenue back in American state

indicators.note: back says the hidden letters are read in reverse order
Some says only part of the following words' letters is used

explanation.surface: Part of a wide avenue at the rear of a US state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes ADAVEN from the middle of 'broad avenue', and 'back' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Nevada is one of the fifty US states, home to Las Vegas.

clue.text: Indifference in a way shown by last in relay

parts.note: a path is a way

indicators.note: last in picks the final letter of the word relay

explanation.surface: A sluggish, uncaring attitude shown by the final runner in a relay team.
explanation.definitionFit: Apathy is a lack of interest or concern, which is what indifference means.

clue.text: National song from social worker over the border

parts.note: an ant is a social insect and a worker in its colony
a hem is the border of a garment

explanation.surface: A national song sung by a social worker who has crossed a frontier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' sounds like a care professional but is the insect that lives in colonies.
explanation.definitionFit: A national anthem is a country's official patriotic song.

clue.text: Boy joins vessel, an East Asian one

definitions.note: one stands for vessel, picked up from the wordplay

parts.note: Sam is a boy's name
a pan is a cooking vessel

explanation.surface: A boy joins the crew of an Asian ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' is used twice: as a pan in the wordplay, then as a boat in the definition, which 'one' refers back to.
explanation.definitionFit: A sampan is a flat-bottomed wooden boat used in China and South-East Asia.

clue.text: Hinders the development of daring feats

definitions.meaning: plural noun: bold or spectacular acts

explanation.surface: Holding back progress through risky exploits.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to restrict growth, and the noun names dangerous acts performed by daredevils or film doubles.

clue.text: Mishandle popular tea-cake

parts.note: to muff something is to bungle it
in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: Fumbling a popular snack at teatime.
explanation.definitionFit: A muffin is a small bread roll toasted and buttered, a classic British teatime cake.

clue.text: Fruit in a minute!

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit inside the phrase that follows

explanation.surface: A promise that the fruit will arrive shortly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a minute' reads as 'soon', but 'in' signals the letters lie within 'minute'.
explanation.definitionFit: A nut is a dry fruit with a hard shell, botanically a fruit.

clue.text: Narrow sea lane is undeviating, it's said

indicators.note: it's said tells us the word is heard, so a word sounding the same is entered

parts.note: undeviating means straight, without bends

explanation.surface: A narrow shipping lane is described as perfectly direct.
explanation.definitionFit: A strait is a narrow channel of water joining two seas.

clue.text: Open out one French sheep pen

parts.note: un is French for one
a fold is an enclosure for sheep

explanation.surface: A French farmer opens up a sheep enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: To unfold is to spread out something that was folded, so to open it out.

clue.text: Modification to fit in each British tank

indicators.note: a modification is an alteration, so the letters of the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Changes are made so that something fits inside each British tank.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chieftain was the British Army's main battle tank from the 1960s to the 1990s.
